messages:
Maya (Product): thanks for popping into the all-hands thread :wave: quick ask — can leads drop 1-line owners + rough weeks for the API GA, Console dashboard parity (per-route metrics + token breakdown), and Optimize feature rollouts (batching autosuggest, quant recs)? i want a single source for timelines so PM/sales know what to promise.
David C: API GA status: feature set mostly locked. blocker = a throughput regression we're tracking under high-concurrency tests. aim: land perf fix + run canary early next week. target: mid-May for GA if no regressions.
Jordan (Eng): the regression is a KV-cache path bug; PR in review, perf bench passes locally. can start a small canary ~48h after merge.
Eli - ML: Optimize roadmap: prioritize batching autosuggest v1 (low risk), then quant recommendations v1 (needs more evals). i'll own quant recs and will add a minimal eval harness this sprint.
Sophie L: Console: per-route metrics UI prototype ready; token breakdown UI needs product polish. i'll ship the prototype to QA by end of sprint, token UI in following sprint.
Sam Ops: quick ops note — Dedicated customers need an explicit migration path for GA changes; we should draft a short migration checklist.
Zach: SDKs — confirm Node/Python parity. i'll open two tiny PRs: pinned client changes + changelog. want to avoid runtime breakage.
Maya (Product): ideal output here = a single row per feature in the tracker with: owner, canary start, GA target, rollout % plan, docs owner. can people paste their rows here or update the tracker? link: https://internal.redwood/roadmap (owner-only link)
Jordan (Eng): putting mine here: "API GA — Jordan — canary start week of Apr 28 — GA mid-May — rollout plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with automated rollback"
Sophie L: Console parity row: "Sophie — per-route metrics canary week of Apr 21 — token-breakdown GA week of May 12 — scope: dashboards + drilldown"
Eli - ML: Optimize rows: "Eli — batching autosuggest canary May 1 — quant recs canary May 15 (eval gating) — GA staggered after safety checks"
David C: David row: "David — runtime perf fix landed by Apr 18 if PR passes — will coordinate rollouts with Jordan"
ReleaseBot: ReleaseBot: canary job created for api-v4.2 at 2630123500 — 10% traffic route us-west-2 :rocket:
Zach: SDK row: "Zach — Node + Py client compatibility patch by Apr 20, changelog + migration notes ready"
Sam Ops: i'll draft the Dedicated migration checklist, putting it in the tracker tonight.
Maya (Product): awesome — last ask: owners, please add a short test/acceptance check under your row (what proved GA-ready). even one bullet helps. i'll consolidate after EOD. :thumbsup:
